grounding.states: Ontario Structured Psychotherapy gives free, publicly funded CBT to adults with depression or anxiety, including OCD or PTSD
grounding.from: Adults with depression and anxiety-related concerns can get free, publicly funded cognitive-behavioural therapy through OSP. Eligibility includes being 18 or older, living in Ontario, and having depression, anxiety or an anxiety-related condition such as OCD or post-traumatic stress.

value.answer: Free option first: Ontario Structured Psychotherapy gives free, publicly funded CBT for adults with depression or anxiety, including OCD or PTSD. You don't need a health card or family doctor, and you can refer yourself. It runs online, by phone or in person. I couldn't find which local network covers your part of Toronto, so search for Ontario Structured Psychotherapy and the referral form will get you to yours. Cheaper private options: Radcliffe Psychotherapy Clinic gives 5 free sessions with student therapists, then $50 plus HST. Get Reconnected has supervised intern sessions at $45. Affordable Therapy Services has online sessions from $50 on a sliding scale. Those prices come from pages that are months old, so they may have changed.
